parameters.text: ={{ 'You are editing an existing Ukrainian Telegram moderation draft according to a moderator instruction. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: relevant (boolean), confidence (number 0..1), quality_score (number 0..1), reason (non-empty string), draft_title (non-empty string), draft_text (non-empty string), risks (array of strings), suggested_tags (array of strings). Apply the instruction carefully while preserving facts supported by the source. Do not invent facts. Keep all human-readable values in Ukrainian. Do not put the source URL in draft_title or draft_text. Preserve official names such as NVIDIA, OpenAI, GitHub, CUDA, PostgreSQL and JavaScript. If the instruction is ambiguous, make a conservative useful improvement. Re-evaluate confidence and quality_score for this candidate; do not copy scores mechanically. Current title: ' + $json.draft_title + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Current text: ' + $json.draft_text + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Current reason: ' + ($json.reason || '') + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Moderator instruction: ' + $json.edit_instruction + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Source title: ' + $json.source_title + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Source URL: ' + $json.source_url + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Source text: ' + ($json.source_text || '') }}

parameters.text: ={{ 'You are regenerating a Telegram moderation candidate. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: relevant (boolean), confidence (number 0..1), quality_score (number 0..1), reason (non-empty string), draft_title (non-empty string), draft_text (non-empty string), risks (array of strings), suggested_tags (array of strings). Every human-readable value MUST be Ukrainian (uk-UA). Create a genuinely fresh draft based only on the source; do not copy the previous draft mechanically. Do not invent facts. Do not put a source URL in draft_title or draft_text. Preserve official names such as NVIDIA, OpenAI, GitHub, CUDA, PostgreSQL and JavaScript. Score calibration: evaluate confidence and quality_score independently for this item, never copy scores from another item, use two decimal places in 0.01 increments, and do not use 0.95 or 0.90 as defaults. Confidence: 0.50-0.64 weak or ambiguous; 0.65-0.79 plausible with gaps; 0.80-0.89 strong evidence; 0.90-1.00 near-certain direct evidence. If relevant is false, confidence must be below 0.50. Quality: 0.50-0.64 poor or fragmentary; 0.65-0.79 usable but incomplete; 0.80-0.89 clear and useful; 0.90-1.00 exceptionally complete and precise. Source title: ' + $json.source_title + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Source URL: ' + $json.source_url + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'Source text: ' + ($json.article_text || '') }}
